comparison.objective: Choose the correctly sized blood-pressure cuff and place it accurately on a training arm.
comparison.physical_skill: Size selection and rigid cuff placement around an arm versus fine fastener access, collar adjustment, and dynamic-response iteration.
comparison.success_condition: The 8 cm cuff alone meets centering, edge, tilt, and turn tolerances versus two safe repeatable axial stops.
comparison.reason: This is selection plus placement based on cuff-width guidance, with no locking or physical test cycle. The body supplies scoring thresholds; no spec versions are available.
